QuestInfo.name: Recovered Watch
QuestInfo.0: Ask Mr. Pickall about the Old Gold Watch again.
QuestInfo.1: You gave the Old Gold Watch back to Alex.
QuestInfo.2: Alex got the Old Gold Watch back, and should be able to return home soon. Something about the look on his face makes you think he's not leaving the city anytime soon, though...

0.0: Ha! Is there anything I can't open? Now, about the Old Gold Watch... I do indeed have it. You held up your end of the bargain, so here. Take it to Alex, sell it to someone else, I don't care what you do with it.

no.0: Well, our deal was your work for the watch. You aren't getting anything else out of me!

1.0: How'd it go? You got my mom's watch?

yes.0: Thanks a lot! Maybe now I can get off the streets.

lost.0: Don't tell me you LOST it! You klutz!
